## Discussion

- Two HRS Core classification approaches
  - Rule-based Core algorithm; probabilistic PMM classification
  - Same HRS/HCAP learning target; distinct measurement and classification assumptions
  - [Provenance:analysis methods]
- Primary comparison
  - HRS/HCAP Algorithm; agreement and marginal-distribution evidence
  - [Provenance: Tables 2-4]
- Secondary comparisons
  - Consensus: small validation subset; inverse-probability weights
  - Langa-Weir and Hudomiet: established HRS comparators; different development targets
  - [Provenance: R/A7_100-comparison_of_diagnoses.R]
- Interpretation limits
  - Classification agreement; no clinical diagnostic validation outside HCAP consensus subset
  - MCI boundary; model-dependent and threshold-dependent assignments
  - PMM agreement with the HRS/HCAP Algorithm is in-sample (apparent error rate; McLachlan, 1992); expected to be optimistic relative to application in new samples
  - [Provenance: analysis design; inference; R/PMM_103_calibration_model.R]
